Mental Health Awareness and Climate Distress Discussed

Discussions around mental health emphasize that coping with daily life does not always indicate well-being, highlighting the importance of acknowledging mental health struggles. Separately, the concept of 'climate distress' is being discussed in the context of World Mental Health Day, suggesting a link between environmental concerns and psychological well-being.
